title: 认识激光切割机
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/01_Laser Cutter 1 Intro.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/01_Laser Cutter 1 Intro/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在创客空间里一台桌面式激光切割机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a bright makerspace beside a closed desktop laser cutter with a dark lid and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来认识激光切割机。

shots.scene: 木板、木尺、齿轮三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a wooden board, a small wooden ruler and a gear. No people.
shots.narration: 它是什么，能做什么，先看一看。

shots.scene: 阿杰在创客空间门口，看着架子上的激光木制作品两眼放光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the door of a makerspace, staring with excitement at shelves of laser-cut wooden crafts.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次来创客空间，看什么都新鲜。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一块镂空小木件，满脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small laser-cut wooden ornament with a lace pattern and looks puzzled.
shots.narration: 这些木制品，是怎么做出来的？

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指向桌上的激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points to a desktop laser cutter on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：都是那台机器做的。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从头开始，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧一叠空白课程卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small stack of blank course cards fanned out like playing cards.
shots.narration: 这一系列课，讲激光切割的基础。

shots.scene: 小研站在激光切割机旁，向几名学生介绍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside a desktop laser cutter and introduces it to a small group of students.
shots.narration: 也讲这里这台设备该怎么用。

shots.scene: 一排编号空白课程卡依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A row of blank lesson cards with numbers one to seven lights up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 你需要知道的，都会一一讲到。

shots.scene: 桌面式激光切割机外观，盖子关闭
shots.prompt_en: A closed desktop laser cutter with a tinted viewing window sits on a sturdy bench. No people.
shots.narration: 这是一台二氧化碳激光切割机。

shots.scene: 机器内部示意：激光头射出一束光点在木板上
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a laser cutter: a laser head above a wooden board, a small bright dot where the beam meets the board. No people.
shots.narration: 功率55瓦，是一台产生激光的机器。

shots.scene: 木板、亚克力板和其他板材三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a wooden board, a clear acrylic sheet and a stack of other sheets with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 能加工木板、亚克力等材料。

shots.scene: 切断、刻深、浅划三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Three small icons: a board cut through by a line, a deeply engraved letter, and a light thin line on a board. No people.
shots.narration: 可以切割、划线，也可以雕刻。

shots.scene: 架子上摆着照片雕刻的木板和地图雕刻木板
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a wooden plaque engraved with a blank portrait picture and another engraved with a simple map outline. No people.
shots.narration: 可以把照片、地图雕在木板上。

shots.scene: 木拼图和带插槽的小木盒
shots.prompt_en: A wooden jigsaw puzzle and a small wooden box with finger joints on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 可以做拼图，也能做小木盒。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一把小木尺端详
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small wooden ruler and looks at it with interest.
shots.narration: 还能做一把小小的尺子。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一枚小木尺徽章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small wooden ruler badge with a blank name area on top.
shots.narration: 大家的第一个作品，就是徽章尺。

shots.scene: 木尺徽章放大图，三处分别亮起
shots.prompt_en: A large illustration of a wooden ruler badge; its outline, its name area and its tick marks light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 切割、划线、雕刻，它全都用上了。

shots.scene: 一大块木板，激光沿四边走一圈切下小木条
shots.prompt_en: A large wooden sheet; a dashed outline of a small rectangle is cut out along its four sides. No people.
shots.narration: 先从大木板上，沿四边切下来。

shots.scene: 木尺上方的名字区域被刻成较深的凹槽
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the top of the wooden ruler: a name area engraved as a deeper recessed block with blank letter shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 上面雕刻名字，刻得比较深。

shots.scene: 木尺下方一排细细的刻度线和数字
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the bottom of the wooden ruler: a row of fine, light tick marks with small number marks. No people.
shots.narration: 刻度用划线，只是浅浅的一层灼痕。

shots.scene: 三块剖面示意：切透、深槽、浅痕
shots.prompt_en: Three cross-section diagrams of a board: one cut all the way through, one with a deep groove, one with a very shallow mark. No people.
shots.narration: 同一束激光，深浅不同，效果不同。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：齿轮、木板、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a gear, a stack of boards and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 后面几课讲原理、材料和安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣点点头，翻开空白课程表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and opens a blank course schedule booklet.
shots.narration: 哪些材料能用、哪些不能，都会讲。

shots.scene: 小研站在激光切割机旁比出手势
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the laser cutter and gestures as if explaining.
shots.narration: 还会讲怎样安全地使用它。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现激光切割机和三种加工图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a laser cutter and three small icons: a cut line, an engraving and a light line.
shots.narration: 激光切割机能切、能雕、能划线。

shots.scene: 照片雕刻、拼图、木盒、木尺四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an engraved picture plaque, a jigsaw puzzle, a small wooden box and a wooden ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 照片、拼图、木盒、尺子都能做。

shots.scene: 木尺徽章图标，切透、深刻、浅划三处标注
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wooden ruler badge with three highlighted parts: outline, name area and tick marks. No people.
shots.narration: 徽章尺：切边、刻名、划刻度。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着做好的木尺徽章向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold up a finished wooden ruler badge and wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 下一课，我们讲激光切割安全，再见！
